text:
maria: hitting flaky SSE ordering in sample-app after reconnects. UI gets partial text duplicated or out of order when i toggle network during long responses.
maria: short tcp log:
```
[2026-09-02T09:10:01.000Z] conn id=xyz open
[2026-09-02T09:10:01.200Z] sse id=1 data=tok...
[2026-09-02T09:10:01.450Z] client ECONNRESET
[2026-09-02T09:10:01.700Z] reconnect resume_id=xyz rseq=1
[2026-09-02T09:10:01.920Z] sse id=4 data=...
[2026-09-02T09:10:02.050Z] sse id=2 data=...
[2026-09-02T09:10:02.200Z] sse id=4 data=... (duplicate)
```
maria: using browser-sdk v0.9.7-dev. stream reader is naive fetch+getReader loop.
sam: do you send Last-Event-ID on reconnect? is server emitting `id:` per chunk?
maria: server does emit `id:`. i wasn't sending Last-Event-ID originally; adding it cut duplicates but ordering still flips sometimes.
kelsey: likely race: old socket lingering while new one opens; runtime may write overlapping tails to both sockets, or proxy reorders packets. what proxy are you using locally?
maria: http-proxy-middleware -> staging runtime. tcp dump shows server wrote to both sockets briefly.
sam: client mitigations: 1) send Last-Event-ID on reconnect, 2) de-dupe on id/hash, 3) jittered reconnect backoff to avoid parallel reconnect storms. SDK could offer opt-in "robustResume" to encapsulate this.
kelsey: infra mitigation: server should avoid emitting same chunk to old socket after resume detected; proxy should properly drain old connections. i'll open an infra ticket and review proxy configs.
maria: i'll open a sample-app PR that persists last id, sets Last-Event-ID, keeps small LRU of seen ids, and bumps SDK to v0.9.8-dev. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sample-app/pull/189
dev-bot: CI: sample-app-ci #711 passed (tests: 128) :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — i'll also draft a short runbook for sample-app devs about resume semantics and file the tcp capture in the infra ticket. tagging @kelsey for follow-up.
